_comment: CR-390: Insights Basic module manifest (OD-390-12 locked — 13 daily-use reports)

states.title: Sales Dashboard
states.description: Sales KPIs, charts and top items for the selected period.

states.title: Sales Overview
states.description: Revenue by channel, payment mode and order type.

states.title: Daily Sales Summary
states.description: Day-by-day revenue trend with order count and average ticket.

states.title: Hourly Sales Curve
states.description: Revenue and order volume distributed across hours of the day.

states.title: Day-of-Week Trend
states.description: Busiest days of the week by revenue and order count.

states.title: Items Ledger
states.description: Item-wise sales: quantity sold, revenue and contribution percentage.

states.title: Item Sales
states.description: Detailed item-level sales with GST breakdown.

states.title: Payments Overview
states.description: Revenue split by payment mode: Cash, Card, UPI, Online.

states.title: Cashier Settlement
states.description: Per-cashier settlement with collection totals and variance.

states.title: Discount Report
states.description: Discount usage by type, amount and percentage of revenue.

states.title: Cancellations
states.description: Cancelled orders and items with reason and waiter details.

states.title: Table-wise Sales
states.description: Revenue and order count per table over the selected period.

states.title: Expense Report
states.description: Expense breakdown by category with trend over time.
